comment: Each entry is a (scenario, op?, language) expected to FAIL today. CI asserts the observed failure set equals exactly this set. When a fix lands, delete its entry here so CI flips green. See conformance/README.md.

gaps.note: Config keys are global per database; the namespace only covers kv/ratelimit/blob today. Fix: namespace config keys so apps sharing a database are isolated.
Queue names are global per database. Fix: prefix queue names with the namespace.
Sessions are global per database; a session from one app validates in another. Fix: add an app/namespace column scoping sessions (and api keys).
